scenes.stage_direction: Phone contact becomes tangible. Let Amara listen before David interprets what the new evidence means.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Her dependant is protected. She can speak without abandoning them.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Tell her I understand being frightened. I still need her to help.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: She has agreed to name the district.

metadata.evidence_summary: The carer can cooperate without abandoning her family.
